parsed.why: National seat under national law. The facilities ban is attached by Congress and enforced here (December 2024 arrests), and local protections can be overridden. The low-risk placement is durable only while national action stays quiet, so it sits just below the parent average.

Gender-affirming care for minors is banned, and flag and care restrictions add to it. Sodomy law is repealed, which is only tangential.

Marker change is by affidavit. The 2023 panic-defence bill is unsigned, and violence records are absent, so the score is moderate.

Correctional protections exist in law but are rated short in practice. Facilities access for visitors is unresolved, so the score stays in Reduced Risk.

Most-protective tier with gender-identity public-accommodation protection, hate-crime and panic-defence repeal, and self-determined markers. Shield laws are enforceable against out-of-state action, gender-neutral bathrooms are mandated, and no state facilities ban applies. National passport and entry rules still apply.
